concept: restrained scholarly productivity tool with card-game interaction logic

files.title: Overview / Private Card Repository
files.caption: A focused academic workspace: documents are research cards, modules are slots, the composer is the command hand.

files.title: Import / Add Materials To Deck
files.caption: Incoming files become structured document cards through parsing, OCR, and metadata extraction.

files.title: Library / Index Card Catalog
files.caption: A quiet card binder for searching, filtering, and reopening scholarly materials.

files.title: Reading / Active Page Card
files.caption: One source page is active at a time, with a companion translation card and page deck.

files.title: Composer / Current Hand
files.caption: Agent actions live in the Codex-like composer; plus opens restrained command cards.

files.title: Modules / Equip Function Cards
files.caption: Optional tools are equipped as cards instead of crowding the permanent UI.

files.title: Active Modules / Floating Card
files.caption: Equipped modules open as movable cards with bookmark tabs, not blocking sidebars.

files.title: OCR / Inspect And Repair Card
files.caption: Raw OCR, normalized text, confidence, and warnings are visible without turning the app into a settings panel.

files.title: Translation / Revision Stack
files.caption: Drafts, polish, comments, and terminology checks become inspectable revision cards.

files.title: Glossary / Term Deck
files.caption: Terminology is managed as an active deck that can be filtered, confirmed, and reused.

files.title: Notes / File Thought Cards
files.caption: Quotes and agent suggestions become temporary or archived note cards.

files.title: Export / Assemble Word Bundle
files.caption: Formal output is assembled by choosing cards: translation, source, comments, glossary, and report.

files.title: Collaboration / Assignment Cards
files.caption: Team work is represented as page, segment, OCR, term, and export task cards.

files.title: History / Save Slot Stack
files.caption: Past translations are stored as selectable version cards, not hidden logs.

files.title: Settings / Card Back Configuration
files.caption: Advanced technical controls stay behind calm defaults and expandable card backs.
